definitions.explanation: To apply or enter for something, such as a job or contest.

examples.japanese: {求人|きゅうじん}に{応募|おうぼ}する。
{応募者|おうぼしゃ}が{多|おお}い。

notes:
{応募|おうぼ} is a noun/suru-verb meaning to apply or enter (for jobs, contests, etc.).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {応募|おうぼ}する (to apply)
- {応募|おうぼ}{締|し}め{切|き}り (application deadline)
- {応募|おうぼ}{用紙|ようし} (application form)
- {応募|おうぼ}{資格|しかく} (eligibility requirements)
- {応募者|おうぼしゃ} (applicant)

DISTINCTION:
- {応募|おうぼ}: applying for jobs, contests, programs
- {申|もう}し{込|こ}み: general application/registration
